### Functions

- `Guard.any(_: any): (boolean, string?)`
- `Guard.integer(value: any): (boolean, string?)`
- `Guard.optional(check: Check): Check`
  nil OR matches `check`.
- `Guard.literal(literal: any): Check`
  Exactly equal to `literal`.
- `Guard.union(...: Check): Check`
  Matches at least one of the given checks.
- `Guard.numberRange(min: number, max: number): Check`
  Number within [min, max].
- `Guard.array(check: Check): Check`
  Array (sequential) where every element matches `check`.
- `Guard.map(keyCheck: Check, valueCheck: Check): Check`
  Map where every key matches keyCheck and every value matches valueCheck.
- `Guard.interface(shape: { [string]: Check }): Check`
  Table where each named field matches its check (extra fields allowed).
- `Guard.strictInterface(shape: { [string]: Check }): Check`
  Like interface, but rejects any field NOT declared in the shape (anti-exploit: a payload may not smuggle extra keys past the validator).
